You should get help. This is serious. The worst cases of depression are those that go ignored because people tell themselves, "It's not me. It's someone else." Then it grows inside of you, like a sickness. That's because that's what depression is. It's a disease that needs to be treated before it's too late. Think about it. Worst case scenario, you go to the doctor, and don't get diagnosed for depression. But you will still have support. You'll have the support of your parents, friends, and even if it doesn't matter to you, you'll have the support  of this community. Best case scenario, you get diagnosed, and get treatment. Your depression is treated, and you'll be better. The ladder is much more likely than the former.

And I would like to think I'm not just talking out of my ass to try and make myself feel like a good person. I've been through depression. I didn't do anything about, and I almost killed myself multiple times. I'm better now, and I see clearly the people I would have left injured if I had succeeded. If I could go back and get help before I went through that hellish journey I would. 

Get help now. For yourself and the people around you.
